title: Console UI: internal Unit Economics dashboard page (filters + drilldowns)
creator: Chloe Martin
description:
Build the internal-only Unit Economics dashboard page in Redwood Console. Implement UI per UX spec (filters, charts, top-N tables, drilldown navigation) and wire up to Unit Economics query APIs.

Context
- Goal metric: blended $/1M output tokens with drilldowns by model(+version/quant profile), region, and customer tier.
- Audience: internal (Finance, Product, Eng). Must be safe by default (no customer-identifiable data in UI).

Links
- PRD (Confluence): /confluence/product-docs/requirements/internal-unit-economics-dashboard-prd
- UX spec (Confluence): /confluence/product-docs/design-specs/unit-economics-dashboard-drilldown-ux-spec
- Metric definitions (Confluence): /confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/unit-economics-dashboard-metrics-and-definitions
- API contract sketch (Drive): /google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/console-and-tooling/unit-economics-api-contract-sketch

Scope (v1)
1) Page + routing
- Add Console nav entry under Internal → "Unit Economics" (gated behind feature flag + RBAC).
- New route: /internal/unit-economics (and drilldowns as nested routes).

2) Filters + state management
- Global filter bar:
  - Time range (default: last 7 days) with presets (24h/7d/30d/QTD) + custom.
  - Model selector (supports model alias, version, quantization profile when available).
  - Region selector (canonical normalized regions).
  - Customer tier selector (self-serve / dedicated / private / enterprise).
  - Streaming toggle (all / streaming only / non-streaming only) if supported by backend.
- Persist filter state in URL query params (shareable links). Example:
  - ?from=2025-02-01T00:00:00Z&to=2025-02-08T00:00:00Z&model=rw-llama-70b&region=us-east-1&tier=dedicated
- Provide a "Reset" action to return to defaults.

3) Primary views
- KPI tiles:
  - Blended cost ($/1M output tokens)
  - Output tokens
  - Total allocated cost ($)
  - Coverage/quality indicator (see below)
- Time series chart:
  - Blended $/1M output tokens over time (hourly or daily depending on range; match API granularity).
- Breakdown / top-N tables (sortable):
  - By model
  - By region
  - By customer tier
  - Optional (if backend supports): by quantization profile
- Clicking a row drills down, carrying global filters + adding the selected dimension.

4) Drilldowns
- Drilldown landing page shows:
  - Header summary for the selected dimension value
  - Time series + secondary breakdowns (e.g., on Model drilldown, show by region and tier)
  - "Contributing signals" panel where available: cache hit rate, batching efficiency, avg output length, prefill/decode ratio (read-only; show "Not available" if null).

5) Data quality / confidence indicator UX
- Display a banner when the API reports incomplete coverage (missing tier/region/model dimension mapping, missing hours, backfill running).
- Prevent silent misreads:
  - Annotate charts when there are missing buckets
  - Show tooltip copy: "Blended cost is allocated; not a per-request marginal price. See definitions."

6) Empty/error/loading states
- Empty state: "No data for selected filters" with quick actions (expand range, clear model, clear region).
- API errors: user-friendly error with request ID + retry.
- Slow responses: skeleton loaders; do not block filter bar interactions.

Non-goals (v1)
- Customer-level drilldowns or anything that exposes customer IDs.
- Saved views / pinned dashboards (tracked separately).
- External customer-facing cost UI.

Implementation notes
- Use shared Console filter components where possible (time range + selectors).
- Avoid waterfall queries: load overview + breakdowns concurrently.
- Client-side caching: leverage existing query cache (e.g., React Query) with TTL aligned to API caching; prefer server-driven caching (ENG-8427/ENG-8426).
- Ensure all queries include the same normalized dimension names as defined in the metric dictionary.

Acceptance criteria
- Page is inaccessible unless user is in allowlist role + feature flag enabled (ENG-8434 dependency).
- Filters round-trip via URL; copy/paste link reproduces the same view.
- Overview KPI + time series render for default range with no console errors.
- Top-N tables render and drilldown navigation works (row click → drilldown route) while preserving filters.
- Empty/error states match UX spec and include request ID for debugging.
- No customer identifiers exposed in UI or payload logging.
- Reviewed by Product (Marissa) and Finance (Rishi/Laura) for correctness of labels/units/copy.

QA checklist
- Validate formatting/rounding (see DES-319):
  - $/1M output tokens with 2 decimals by default; allow more precision in tooltip.
  - Tokens shown as raw integer + compact formatting (e.g., 1.2B).
- Validate time zone handling: display in viewer local time, but keep queries in UTC; day boundary matches Finance expectations.
- Validate that QTD preset uses Finance definition (calendar quarter in UTC unless Finance requests otherwise).

Rollout
- Behind internal feature flag "unit_economics_dashboard".
- Initial allowlist: Finance, Product Console/Optimize, Telemetry/Analytics, SRE oncall.

Notes / open questions
- Do we show both "blended" and "compute-only" (excluding overhead/idle) as a toggle? (Product leaning no for v1; keep in definitions page.)
- Confirm whether backend supports streaming flag as a first-class filter for v1; if not, hide toggle rather than sending null filter.
